g.text: - cancel() iff status ∈ {PLACED, CONFIRMED, READY, DISPATCHING}
- One Order creates exactly one Delivery (V1)
- expire() iff status = PENDING and now ≥ deadline
- At most one PENDING offer per delivery at a time
- idempotencyKey prevents duplicate offers on retry
Local read model — not an aggregate root.
from tracking (one per courier every 15 s).
Retention period: TBD in data model (phase 0.3).
Positions outside an active delivery are kept
for load tests and audit, with a shorter TTL.
SMS and email: logged only in V1
Cross-context references — IDs only, no shared tables:
